_provenance.notes: Single-page (--single) extract; cross-page aggregation degenerates to one page. Home hero is a scroll-scaled <video>, not a static image -> heroImage:null. System-component detection skipped (requires >=3 pages); header + footer captured as structural context only. Dark/light split: top half of page is white/warm-gray surfaces, lower half (studio-banner -> footer) is pure-black sections with white text. Palette dropped white-tint text colors rgba(255,255,255,.48/.6/.72/.8) used on dark sections.
Adobe corporate wordmark, served as SVG from assets/figma-svg/, rendered at height 16px in the nav pill. SVG paths carry the Adobe red fill.

palette.note: Adobe brand red (--s2a-color-brand-adobe-red). Token-defined and carried by the Adobe wordmark logo; not used as a UI surface color. Reserve to brand lockups.

headingFamily.name: Adobe Clean Display
headingFamily.stack: 'adobe-clean-display', 'Adobe Clean Display', 'Adobe Clean', -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

scaleAudit.note: Spectrum-2 discrete type ramp (title-1..4 = 80/56/48/24px), not a single modular scale.

files.sourceCssRule: @font-face { font-family: 'adobe-clean-display'; src: url('assets/fonts/Adobe Clean Display/AdobeCleanDisplay-Black.otf') format('opentype'); font-weight: 900; }

_provenance.notes: Adobe Clean / Adobe Clean Display are proprietary Adobe typefaces (licensingFlag: private). 9 display weights + 5 text weights declared via local @font-face; the live render only fetched Regular, Bold (text) and Black (display) because those are the weights the visible copy uses. Titles are uniformly weight 900 with tight negative tracking and sub-1.0 line-height.
Spectrum-2 spacing tokens xs..6xl (8→96). Section padding-block mode is 96px (stories/acrobat/solutions/product); tutorial uses 80px, search 124px. Grid gutter 8px, side margin 8.333vw ≥768px.

borderRadius.note: 16px = nav pill + cards (--border-radius-md). 12px = inner cards. 999px = buttons/chips/tabs(50px). 32px = stories section top corners. 50% = circular carousel arrows + dots.

shadows.uses: large upward ambient lift on sticky/overlay elements

gradients.uses: hero video scrim / image overlays for white text legibility
product-tile image bottom fade into black section (x4 tiles)

_provenance.notes: Button system is fully pill-shaped (999px), height 40px (sm 32px), weight 700, 200ms cubic-bezier(0.42,0,0,1) transitions. Four variants: primary(blue), dark(black), outline(black 1.5px), ghost-white(white 1.5px + blur).
